title: Area of a Triangle in 3D Space
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the area of the triangle with vertices A(1, 0, 0), B(0, 2, 0), and C(0, 0, 3).

steps.title: Find Edge Vectors from Common Vertex
steps.explanation: Construct edge vectors originating at vertex A.

steps.title: Compute Cross Product AB x AC
steps.explanation: Evaluate the determinant: i(6 - 0) - j(-3 - 0) + k(0 - (-2)) = <6, 3, 2>.
steps.why: Finding normal vector whose length gives parallelogram area.

steps.title: Calculate Half the Magnitude
steps.explanation: Half the parallelogram area yields the triangle area.
